sources.title: EfficientNet · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview The EfficientNet model was proposed in EfficientNet: Rethinking Model Scaling for Convolutional Neural Networks by Mingxing Tan and Quoc V. Le. EfficientNets are a family of image classification models, which achieve state-of-the-art accuracy, yet being an order-of-magnitude smaller and faster than previous models.

sources.title: Efficientnet Architecture - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: EfficientNet has emerged as a beacon of innovation, offering a holistic solution that balances model complexity with computational efficiency. This article embarks on a detailed journey through the intricate layers of EfficientNet, illuminating its architecture, design philosophy, training methodologies, performance benchmarks, and more.
